newsitem.title: USA: Trico sees demand for all vessel classes.
newsitem.headline: Trico sees demand for all vessel classes.

text.p: Trico Marine Services Inc said Tuesday it continues to see "healthy demand and higher rates for all the vessel classes" due to strong activity in the Gulf of Mexico.
And the company said its life boat fleet is experiencing improved market conditions for offshore platform repair and maintenance and well-servicing activities.
Trico Marine provides marine support services to the oil and gas industry, primarily in the Gulf of Mexico and Brazil.
